summary: Connect the admitted parallel dense forward execution to the actual TorchLean real tensor graph.

examined.reason: The selected admitted execution now has stored-word error bounds against the actual TorchLean graph. The proof derives tensor/tree equality and zero-padding removal from explicit operand encodings; universal execution correctness, the empty-output wrapper and parallel backward remain open.

Eleven new public declarations enter the unchanged pinned-build and exact standard-axiom dependency audit. This is a checked connection within existing semantics, with no new claim about source fidelity or hardware conformance.

The child now connects an actual admitted instruction trace to its tensor specification under explicit numerical conditions. This advances the parent end-to-end example responsibility while keeping selected existence separate from universal correctness and broader coverage.

The existing concrete-read admitted execution is reused without modifying its machine, read choices, graph constraints, barrier history or safety contract. The new tensor result adds numerical encoding premises only; it does not assume memory visibility for arbitrary reads.

results.method: bash scripts/check.sh; bash integration/torchlean/check.sh; stratic validate; git diff --check; manual proof, scope and public declaration coverage review.
